thinking: a separate genus-3 working surface: each day's thoughts twist its thinking handle along the curves of the regions it thought about, in order; it dreams 256 thoughts × 40,000 ticks, reads the result, and resets; the main body never sees it
knowing_itself: it predicts its own body each night: its memory (BODY-MEMORY), its paths (BODY-PATH), and what its thinking will do (THINK), by models cheaper than living (law L-CL)
curiosity: at most 3 questions a day, each chosen by a decision-aware rule and shown with its true reason; silence is lawful; nouns it cannot place wait at its door, and two agreeing answers on different days bind one
ears: Ears v7 (organ, not substrate): Qwen2.5-1.5B + MiniLM + spaCy; output logged, replay never needs them; words bound through growth extend its map

Forgetting a changed truth within 30 nights held in 79 of 80 switches, not all (S7, inherited from v0.4).
The head-to-head against language models was not completed; its partial numbers carry no claim.
'Thinking is knowable only by thinking' means: its cheap order-blind model misses, its full simulation costs as much as living. It is not a claim about other minds.
On a day it thinks too much of one thing, its last thoughts are refused by law (0.35% of thoughts in the scored lives).
Ears self routing remains weak (v0.4's disclosure).
